text.en:
The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include
the 7 per cent sales tax.

This Order shall take effect three days after
the date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of Sep-
tember, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
fifty-three, and of the Independence of the Philippines,
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
